title: American Telephone and Telegraph Company 1977 Annual Report
version: Report for 1977, issued in 1978 (chairman’s letter dated 8 February 1978).
lineage: Bell System corporate report, accessed as a Telephone Archive facsimile. It reproduces a statement from Illinois Bell, the participating operating company. The local reading notes identify the inspected scan by SHA-256.

passages.locator: Printed p. 10 / PDF p. 12, High-capacity transmission systems evaluated
passages.note: The operator’s parent company reports that the fiber link was put in commercial service in Chicago in May 1977 while high-capacity transmission systems were still being evaluated.

passages.locator: Printed p. 15 / PDF p. 17, statement by Charles Marshall, Illinois Bell Telephone Company
passages.note: Illinois Bell’s Charles Marshall describes the Chicago installation as a full-service lightwave installation in 1977. The annual report supplies no cutover day or circuit logs.
